page.title: Intro Replacer
page.subtitle: Plays a custom intro before the episode or movie you start, then lets you skip the item's own intro.
settings.title: Settings
settings.moviesOnly.tip: Turning this on skips episodes and seasons. Some TV and mobile apps do not ask for intros on episodes anyway, while movies work everywhere.
introFiles.title: Intro files
introFiles.help: Upload a video file, or pick any video that is already in one of your libraries. Nothing is copied and your media is never modified.
introFolder.label: Intro folder (container path, empty = plugin default)
introFiles.addFromLibrary: Add a video from a library…
rules.title: Rules
rules.help: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom and the first enabled rule that matches wins. A rule with no condition matches every item. Replace lets the client skip the item's own intro, Prepend plays the item from the start.
folder.hint: This is the path inside the Jellyfin container: mount the host folder into the container first (Docker volume), and use a dedicated folder, not a media library root. Files copied into it are added automatically.
assets.empty: No intro videos yet. Upload one, or add a video from a library.
picker.title: Add a video from a library
picker.noVideos: No videos found in your libraries.
picker.limit: Showing the first {rendered} of {total} matches — type more to narrow the list down.
rule.title: Rule {number} — {name}
rule.name: Name
rule.playback.sequential: Play all selected intros in order
rule.placement: What to do with the item's own intro
rule.placement.replace: Replace it (the client can skip the original intro)
rule.placement.prepend: Prepend (play the item from the beginning)
rule.placement.tip: Replace adds an "Intro" segment so the client can skip the original intro (it shows a Skip button). For hands-free skipping, set Playback -> Media Segment Actions -> Intro Segments -> Skip in the client. Prepend removes those markers so the item plays from the start.
rule.frequency.everyTime: Every time you start an episode or movie
rule.frequency.interval: Only after the wait time has passed
rule.frequency.tip: "Every time" plays before the title you start; if you start a list, it plays before the first title only. "Only after the wait time" replays it once the minutes set just below have passed. "Once per session" replays it after you close the app or sign out.
rule.wait: Time to wait before the intro plays again (minutes)
rule.modePick: Use {label} to choose the items this rule applies to
rule.tree.help: Everything is active by default. Uncheck a library, series, season or episode to leave it out; unchecking a level hides the ones under it.
rule.tags.include.tip: Items containing these tags are included in the rule. Exclude tags take priority: an item carrying an exclude tag is left out. Tags are matched against the item and its parent series/season, and any one of them is enough.
error.folder.absolute: Use an absolute folder path (for example /mnt/media/intros).
error.folder.write: That folder cannot be written to. Create it or pick another one.
error.folder.move: Could not move the existing intro files to that folder.
error.video.notPlayable: The selected item is not a playable video file.
